# buf.lint passes on a clean module, fails with buf's findings on a bad one,
# and reruns when buf.yaml changes its rules.
[!exec:buf] skip

bit
stdout 'lint ▶ buf lint'
stdout 'lint ✔ ok'

bit
stdout 'lint · no changes'

cp user.proto.bad proto/acme/v1/user.proto
! bit
stdout 'Field name "user_Name" should be lower_snake_case'
stdout 'lint ✘ tests failed'
stderr 'test target ''lint'' failed'

# A failed check runs again even with nothing changed.
! bit
stdout 'previously failed'

cp buf.yaml.except buf.yaml
bit
stdout 'lint ✔ ok'

bit
stdout 'lint · no changes'

# Restoring the rule reruns the check on buf.yaml alone.
cp buf.yaml.strict buf.yaml
! bit
stdout '''buf\.yaml'' changed'
stdout 'lint ✘ tests failed'

-- BUILD.bit --
lint = buf.lint {}
-- buf.yaml --
version: v2
modules:
  - path: proto
lint:
  use:
    - STANDARD
-- buf.yaml.strict --
version: v2
modules:
  - path: proto
lint:
  use:
    - STANDARD
-- buf.yaml.except --
version: v2
modules:
  - path: proto
lint:
  use:
    - STANDARD
  except:
    - FIELD_LOWER_SNAKE_CASE
-- proto/acme/v1/user.proto --
syntax = "proto3";

package acme.v1;

message User {
  string user_name = 1;
}
-- user.proto.bad --
syntax = "proto3";

package acme.v1;

message User {
  string user_Name = 1;
}
